title: Polymorphic equality on float32 nan returns true
summary: Polymorphic `=` on two boxed `float32` nans returns `true`; `<>`, `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=` also give the opposite of the IEEE answers. With the type known at the comparison the answers are right, so a result can change with inlining.
cause: `runtime/float32.c`, `float32_cmp`, returns the total order and never sets `Caml_state->compare_unordered`, as `runtime/bigarray.c` does.
